steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: select-both-boxes
steps.comment: CSG v2 is selection-driven: enter Select mode and pick both textured boxes as combine operands.
steps.eval: (function() { const selBtn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => /^Select$/.test(b.textContent.trim())); if (selBtn) selBtn.click(); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; ['box 1','box 2'].forEach(nm => { const row = rows.find(r => new RegExp(nm,'i').test(r.textContent || '')); if (row) row.click(); }); })()

steps.name: click-union
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Union selected parts"]'); if (!btn || btn.disabled) throw new Error('Union unavailable'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-union-ready
steps.comment: The non-destructive union evaluates off-thread; Bake enables when the result is ready.

steps.name: bake-union
steps.comment: Bake the union into one 'mesh' part so its per-source textures are frozen into the exported GLB (the v1 behaviour this scenario verifies).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Bake Combine 1 to a mesh"]'); if (!btn || btn.disabled) throw new Error('Bake unavailable'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function() { const inp = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); if (!inp) return; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set.call(inp, 'CSG Texture Test'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.comment: DOM .click(), NOT the harness text-click: 'Save asset' sits below the fold of the scrolling right panel and clickByText clicks the unscrolled bounding-rect centre — silent no-op (see glb-designer-simple.json).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-saved
steps.comment: Real round-trip assertion (not the toast text): GLTFExporter + CC0 texture embedding + IDB write are slow under headless SwiftShader — generous timeout.
steps.failMessage: saving the CSG asset should add a UserGltfDef named 'CSG Texture Test' to state.userFurniture
